name: @pantoken/web-components
description: Framework-agnostic custom elements for Instructure UI: <instui-icon> plus token-styled primitives.

scripts.dev: node scripts/generate.ts && node scripts/build-bundles.ts && node scripts/build-entries.ts && vp pack --watch
scripts.translate: I18N_TRANSLATION_COMMAND=claude I18N_TRANSLATION_COMMAND_ARGS="--model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 --effort low" i18n --config "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/i18n.config.json" translate ui.strings
scripts.translate:agy: I18N_TRANSLATION_COMMAND="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tools/translation-adapters/agy-wrapper.sh" I18N_TRANSLATION_COMMAND_ARGS="--model gemini-3.6-flash-low" i18n --config "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/i18n.config.json" translate ui.strings
scripts.translate:copilot: I18N_TRANSLATION_COMMAND="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tools/translation-adapters/copilot-wrapper.sh" I18N_TRANSLATION_COMMAND_ARGS="--model gpt-5-mini --effort low" i18n --config "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/i18n.config.json" translate ui.strings
